svg.text: Java 21 Project Loom: Virtual Threads (M:N Scheduling)
VT-1 unmounts stack continuation to JVM Heap on blocking I/O so Carrier-1 runs VT-2 without blocking OS threads
Never pool Virtual Threads · 1 VT per task
